BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_i18n (
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (course_id, i18n_id)
);

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.course_version_i18n') IS NOT NULL THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            WITH picked_version AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT ON (cv.course_id)
                    cv.course_id,
                    cv.id AS course_version_id
                FROM course_version cv
                ORDER BY
                    cv.course_id,
                    cv.is_default DESC,
                    (cv.status = 1) DESC,
                    cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST,
                    cv.created_at DESC
            )
            INSERT INTO course_i18n (course_id, i18n_id, title, description)
            SELECT
                pv.course_id,
                cvi.i18n_id,
                cvi.title,
                cvi.description
            FROM picked_version pv
            JOIN course_version_i18n cvi ON cvi.course_version_id = pv.course_version_id
            ON CONFLICT (course_id, i18n_id) DO UPDATE
            SET title = EXCLUDED.title,
                description = EXCLUDED.description
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS module (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    tech_id integer NULL REFERENCES tech(id),
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS module_i18n (
    module_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES module(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (module_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS section (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    tech_id integer NULL REFERENCES tech(id),
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS section_i18n (
    section_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES section(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (section_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_module (
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    module_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES module(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    PRIMARY KEY (course_id, module_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS module_section (
    module_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES module(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    section_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES section(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    PRIMARY KEY (module_id, section_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS course_module_course_order_unique_idx
    ON course_module (course_id, "order");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS module_section_module_order_unique_idx
    ON module_section (module_id, "order");

WITH course_defaults AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS course_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:module:' || c.id::text) AS module_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:section:' || c.id::text) AS section_id,
        COALESCE(c.main_tech_id, first_tech.tech_id) AS tech_id,
        c.status,
        c.created_at,
        c.updated_at
    FROM course c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ct.tech_id
        FROM course_tech ct
        WHERE ct.course_id = c.id
        ORDER BY ct.tech_id
        LIMIT 1
    ) first_tech ON TRUE
)
INSERT INTO module (id, tech_id, status, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT module_id, tech_id, 1, created_at, updated_at
FROM course_defaults
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

WITH course_defaults AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS course_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:module:' || c.id::text) AS module_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:section:' || c.id::text) AS section_id,
        COALESCE(c.main_tech_id, first_tech.tech_id) AS tech_id,
        c.created_at,
        c.updated_at
    FROM course c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ct.tech_id
        FROM course_tech ct
        WHERE ct.course_id = c.id
        ORDER BY ct.tech_id
        LIMIT 1
    ) first_tech ON TRUE
)
INSERT INTO section (id, tech_id, status, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT section_id, tech_id, 1, created_at, updated_at
FROM course_defaults
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

WITH course_defaults AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS course_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:module:' || c.id::text) AS module_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:section:' || c.id::text) AS section_id
    FROM course c
)
INSERT INTO course_module (course_id, module_id, "order", status)
SELECT course_id, module_id, 0, 1
FROM course_defaults
ON CONFLICT (course_id, module_id) DO NOTHING;

WITH course_defaults AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS course_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:module:' || c.id::text) AS module_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:section:' || c.id::text) AS section_id
    FROM course c
)
INSERT INTO module_section (module_id, section_id, "order", status)
SELECT module_id, section_id, 0, 1
FROM course_defaults
ON CONFLICT (module_id, section_id) DO NOTHING;

WITH course_defaults AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS course_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:module:' || c.id::text) AS module_id
    FROM course c
)
INSERT INTO module_i18n (module_id, i18n_id, title, description)
SELECT
    cd.module_id,
    ci.i18n_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.description
FROM course_defaults cd
JOIN course_i18n ci ON ci.course_id = cd.course_id
ON CONFLICT (module_id, i18n_id) DO NOTHING;

WITH course_defaults AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS course_id,
        uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:section:' || c.id::text) AS section_id
    FROM course c
)
INSERT INTO section_i18n (section_id, i18n_id, title, description)
SELECT
    cd.section_id,
    ci.i18n_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.description
FROM course_defaults cd
JOIN course_i18n ci ON ci.course_id = cd.course_id
ON CONFLICT (section_id, i18n_id) DO NOTHING;

ALTER TABLE lesson ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS section_id uuid NULL REFERENCES section(id);

UPDATE lesson l
SET section_id = uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'ms-go-course:section:' || l.course_id::text)
WHERE l.section_id IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE lesson ALTER COLUMN section_id SET NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lesson_section_id ON lesson(section_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_version (
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tech_version_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES tech_version(id),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    PRIMARY KEY (lesson_id, tech_version_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lesson_version_tech_version_id
    ON lesson_version(tech_version_id);

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.course_version') IS NOT NULL THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            INSERT INTO lesson_version (lesson_id, tech_version_id, created_at, status)
            SELECT DISTINCT
                src.lesson_id,
                src.tech_version_id,
                src.created_at,
                src.status
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    l.id AS lesson_id,
                    cv.tech_version_id,
                    COALESCE(cv.published_at, cv.created_at, now()) AS created_at,
                    CASE WHEN cv.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status
                FROM lesson l
                JOIN course_version cv ON cv.id = l.course_version_id
                WHERE cv.tech_version_id IS NOT NULL

                UNION

                SELECT
                    lcv.lesson_id,
                    cv.tech_version_id,
                    COALESCE(cv.published_at, cv.created_at, now()) AS created_at,
                    CASE WHEN cv.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status
                FROM lesson_course_version lcv
                JOIN course_version cv ON cv.id = lcv.course_version_id
                WHERE cv.tech_version_id IS NOT NULL
            ) src
            ON CONFLICT (lesson_id, tech_version_id) DO NOTHING
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS lesson_course_order_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task_course_version_lesson_order_unique_idx;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_section_order_unique_idx
    ON lesson (section_id, "order");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_lesson_order_unique_idx
    ON task (lesson_id, "order");

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS lesson_course_version;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS course_version_i18n;

ALTER TABLE task DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_course_version_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE task DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS course_version_id;

ALTER TABLE lesson DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lesson_course_version_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE lesson DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lesson_course_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE lesson DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS course_version_id;
ALTER TABLE lesson DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS course_id;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS course_version;

COMMIT;
